description: The code description concerns land treatment of soil contaminated by refined fuels, including leaks from underground storage tanks. It specifies registration, landowner consent, siting distances from water, berms/barriers, soil sampling, runoff monitoring and conditions for removing treated soil. These are engineering and operating constraints for a remediation process. The description states an effective date of September 15, 2008. Numerical thresholds and current amendments are unverified because the legal body was not read; the record does not assess whether a particular site complies. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue supplies the original Alberta identifiers and distribution descriptions. The source names Alberta King's Printer Terms of Use. Costs and present file access remain unverified. This record covers inspected descriptive metadata; no dataset, document, archive or linked resource body was fetched. Specific simulation uses are unstated unless described above. Unlisted fields and numerical values remain unknown.
